messages:
anya (pm): Proposal: a "vetted fast-onramp" for low-risk models with explicit pin-grace windows and benchmark gates. Aim: speed + predictable customer migrations. Outline below.
dev (eng): Sounds good. Constraints: must auto-run evals and have clear rollback triggers. Keep gate set small.
maria (sre): Ops ask: p95 latency delta, error-rate threshold, and infra-util caps. Suggest p95 < +20%, error < +0.5% abs, infra < 80%.
tim (support): Support needs a one-line customer script and a table of who is pinned vs eligible. Pinned customers should be opt-out by default.
kevin (prod-ops): Timeline: shadow 7d, small canary (5%) 4d, ramp to 25% over 3 days, soft-deprecate opt-in window 30d. Pin-grace default 30d configurable.
dev (eng): Proposed gates: p95_latency_rel:0.20, error_rate_abs:0.005, eval_regression_abs:0.02, token_cost_rel:+0.10. Rollback if eval_regression>0.03 or error_rate>0.01.
anya (pm): Comms: in-console banner + email 10d before auto-migrate + migration FAQ. Incentive: small credit for early opt-ins.
maria (sre): Add auto-fallback to previous pinned variant on rollback trigger. Also create incident channel before run.
notify-bot: scheduled: `onramp 5177771234 --model redwood/opt-lite --policy vetted_fast_onramp_v1` :gear:
anya (pm): Decision list: approve thresholds (eng+sre), confirm timeline (ops), finalize comms + incentive (pm+support). Aim to sign-off by Wed to start shadow next Mon.
dev (eng): I'll validate perf numbers by Tue.
maria (sre): I'll own the runbook and alerts.
tim (support): I'll draft customer-facing copy once incentive confirmed.
kevin (prod-ops): OK from ops.
anya (pm): Closing — will post final doc and signoff checklist here.
